note: Temp news strip shown just above the main tab menu. Edit 'items' to change the news; set 'show' to false to hide the whole strip. Each item: 'text' (required), 'icon' (Font Awesome classes, optional), 'label' (short uppercase prefix, optional), 'link' (optional URL, makes the pill clickable), 'informalOnly' (true to show the item only when the Informal Bio switch is on).
